items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1972-05-19
items.q: Billy and Dee Dee was rehearsing at my house. That's where they started. ... Billy and Dee Dee lived at my house. They'd sleep by my house and everything.

ctx.x: the whole thing. How did Dee used to play with you? I never heard you mention your

username. Who? Dee Dee. Well Dee Dee and Billy, well they know, you didn't know Dee Dee and Billy, but they started with me. Billy and Dee Dee was rehearsing at my house. That's where they started. Oh yeah? Billy and Dee Dee started right at my house. They practiced every day. It was Sunday. Billy and Dee Dee lived at my house. They'd sleep by my house and everything. Billy and Dee Dee. You played with Mr. Bucko Grammer? Bucko Grammer, Dijama, Gagne. I'm about to see to get them bitches. Yeah, I like seeing.…
A little tin flute? Yeah, tin flute. Paul Barnes learned how to play that. How much did those flutes cost then? We used to pay ten cents for them.
